name: Button
purpose: Primary or secondary action within a content area.

elements.label: Text label. Omitted only with the icon modifier, which then requires aria-label.
elements.spinner: Loading indicator; replaces the content without changing the width.

behavior: Visual feedback on touch-down, action on release.
Loading blocks activation and keeps the measured width.

a11y.notes: Icon-only buttons must set aria-label. Hit area >= hit-area.min.

lvgl.notes: Variants and sizes as enums; states via LV_STATE_PRESSED / LV_STATE_DISABLED / LV_STATE_FOCUSED.
